notes: Account overview: internal engineering org focused on developer productivity + code search across monorepos and internal docs.
Primary pain: current search returns noisy results for code snippets; re-ranking + reranker latency required for dev flow.
Scale: ~120M embedding vectors currently; expecting 500k new vectors/week due to CI/regression runs.
Indexing pattern: frequent partial re-index (per-repo delta), nightly full snapshots, spikes on release days.
Performance targets: interactive code search — p95 end-to-end < 200ms, ideal p95 < 120ms for single-node queries. Throughput: 200 qps sustained during peak developer hours.
Cost sensitivity: high — engineering leadership wants <$0.002 per query averaged across reranked flow. Finance asked for 12-month TCO comparison vs current Elastic + custom ANN.

Model preferences: high recall base with learned reranker for precision. Interested in transformer-based reranker (distilled) + lower-cost dense retrieval model. Open to quantized/resident model variants.
Routing needs: prefer routing queries to dedicated pools in NA region; fallbacks to hosted lower-cost variant for batch/background jobs.
Security: SSO/SAML required, SCIM for user sync later. Must support KMS-wrapped keys and long-term audit log retention (2+ years). Data residency in US only.
Operational: want automatic incremental reembedding (on commit events) and ability to backfill on demand; requires connector to internal event bus and S3-like object store.
Quote from Eng Manager: "We need dev search to feel instant — 100ms is the difference between adoption and bypass."
POC ask: ingest 5M representative vectors; run search + rerank perf suite (p50/p95/p99), measure cost per query and bytes transferred; show autoscaling impact under bursty CI traffic.
Security review: completed SOC2 questionnaire draft; waiting on SAML metadata and pen-test scope. Key open Qs: will Redwood accept customer-managed HSM? (they prefer yes).
Technical notes: current infra uses custom sharded ANN with occasional cold-start latency ~400ms; want prefix/KV caching for hot repo queries and cache invalidation semantics tied to commit events.
Integration stubs: provided example webhook for reindex trigger, sample gRPC spec for streaming reembedding, and suggested batch path for nightly snapshot.
Risks: embedding volume growth may increase storage costs — suggested plan: mixed precision + product-level TTL and hot/cold index separation.
Next internal step: SE to create POC runbook with explicit perf scripts + cost telemetry (instrument token-level cost) and deliver to Tidewater by 2026-03-10.
requirements_summary: Workload type: code search + internal knowledge (RAG) where reranking is applied post-recall
Indexing scale: ~120M vectors today, growth ~2-5% weekly, delta reindex per-commit (~10k/day)
Latency targets: p95 <= 200ms (goal 120ms) for interactive dev queries; background batch queries can tolerate higher latency
Throughput: 200 qps sustained peak, burst to 2k qps during release windows
Cost per query: target <$0.002 avg across full rerank pipeline
Model stack: dense retrieval model (quantized) + distilled transformer reranker; willingness to use Redwood-verified variants
Reindexing: incremental real-time triggers + nightly full snapshots; ability to backfill and resume interrupted jobs
Security: SAML SSO, KMS/HSM, audit logs retention 2+ years, US-only data residency
Deployment: private VPC preferred; on-prem eval acceptable for air-gapped teams in org
Operational controls: fine-grained rollout (canary), tracing hooks, token-level cost attribution, per-model dashboards
